events.title: Life Core Demo Is Now Live!
events.summary: We’re excited to announce that the Life Core Demo is now available!In the demo, you’ll begin your journey toward Gartos, the first planet featured in the full game and face our first major enemy, The Alpha.Wield your sword, our first playable melee weapon, discover powerful upgrades, grow stronger and do your best to survive the final encounter.As you play, please keep in mind that many systems are still in development and do not yet represent their final versions. events.title: Leaderboard is here
events.summary: The Leaderboard system is now available in the demo.You can compete for the fastest completion times through both Global and Friends leaderboards, and compare your runs with other players.We’re also planning to expand the system with additional leaderboard categories and competitive features in future updates.(The times shown in the image are for illustrative purposes only)

events.title: Demo soon
events.summary: Hello everyone,We’ve been a bit quiet for a while, but development on Life Core has been continuing steadily behind the scenes.We’re getting closer to releasing our first playable demo, and from this point forward we’ll start sharing more frequent updates about the game’s progress.For our first devlog, we wanted to share some of the recent UI improvements we’ve been working on, along with an early look at the Power Core selection screen.More updates coming soon.
